_comment: Image-specific copy only — no layout/position/size here, that all lives in layouts.json. Keyed by image id so a post's copy can only ever come from its own matching id. accentLineIndex is the 0-based headline line rendered in the locked accent color instead of the locked headline color — usually the last line, for a 'building to one emphasized word/phrase' rhythm, but that's a convention, not a rule.
